name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Companion desktop app (Windows tray/WinExe, Linux autostart and launcher, single-instance, SHA256SUMS installers), lifecycle hardening (no automatic media helper on fresh install, persisted Stop, credential ACLs, safer updater), Storage tab review, and friend-callback SSRF hardening that connects only to public resolved addresses.
